districts.name: Raffles Place · Marina
districts.areas: Cecil · Marina · People's Park · Boat Quay · Anson
districts.pov: Office-led core. Resi here is investor-only ,  yields tight, demand cyclical with CBD office occupancy.

districts.name: Anson · Tanjong Pagar
districts.pov: Walking-distance CBD play. Newport (FH) is the headline 2026 launch ,  prime tier.

districts.name: Queenstown · Tiong Bahru
districts.pov: City-fringe sweet spot. Mature MRT, quality schools, en-bloc-rich. Holds value through cycles.

districts.name: Sentosa · HarbourFront
districts.pov: Sentosa = niche FX/foreign-buyer game. HarbourFront mainland is the more practical SC/PR play.

districts.name: Pasir Panjang · Clementi
districts.areas: Pasir Panjang · West Coast · Clementi · Hong Leong Garden
districts.pov: Quietly strong. NUS / one-north / Science Park demand pillars. Tenant-friendly, mature stock.

districts.name: City Hall · High Street
districts.areas: High Street · Beach Road · Clarke Quay
districts.pov: Tiny district by sales volume. Mostly old commercial-resi mixed-use.

districts.name: Beach Road · Bugis
districts.pov: Gentrifying fast. Guoco Midtown anchor. F&B + creative tenant pool.

districts.name: Little India · Farrer Park
districts.areas: Farrer Park · Little India · Jalan Besar
districts.pov: Underrated CCR-fringe. Yield-friendly. Renter base is Indian professional + medical (Farrer Park Hospital).

districts.name: Orchard · River Valley
districts.pov: Singapore's prime-of-prime. Liquidity strong, FX-driven. Quiet luxury > bling. Watch foreign-buyer cycle.

districts.name: Bukit Timah · Holland
districts.pov: Family prime. School zones (NJC/HCI/MGS) drive premium. Landed enclave premium intact.

districts.name: Novena · Newton
districts.pov: Health corridor (NSC/Tan Tock Seng/Mt Elizabeth). Family-friendly, MRT-rich.

districts.name: Balestier · Toa Payoh
districts.pov: City-fringe HDB-heavy. Toa Payoh's en-bloc supply re-shapes mid-2030s.

districts.name: Macpherson · Braddell
districts.pov: Quiet performer. CCL access. Affordable RCR for upgraders.

districts.name: Geylang · Eunos
districts.areas: Geylang · Eunos · Paya Lebar · Ubi · Aljunied
districts.pov: Two-speed: Geylang FH + Paya Lebar Quarter mature; Ubi industrial-fringe stays niche. Yield-positive.

districts.name: East Coast · Katong
districts.areas: Katong · Joo Chiat · Marine Parade · Amber Road · Mountbatten
districts.pov: East Coast lifestyle premium. Walkable, cafe-rich, mature schools. New launches priced accordingly.

districts.name: Bedok · Upper East Coast
districts.areas: Bedok · Upper East Coast · Eastwood · Bayshore
districts.pov: Bayshore TEL station + Bedok CBD redevelopment = 5, 10yr upside. HDB upgrader-rich catchment.

districts.name: Changi · Loyang
districts.pov: Industrial-anchored. Tenant pool = aviation + CBP staff. Resi is niche; landed pockets only.

districts.name: Tampines · Pasir Ris
districts.pov: Mature regional centre. Tampines Hub + JEM-equivalent retail draw. Pinery Residences is the 2026 anchor.

districts.name: Serangoon · Hougang · Punggol
districts.pov: Family-suburban. Punggol Digital District ramping. HDB-upgrader heartland for Crestbrick.

districts.name: Bishan · Ang Mo Kio
districts.pov: Education + connectivity (TEL+NSL). Premium HDB resale. Thomson View en-bloc 2026 = signal.

districts.name: Upper Bukit Timah · Clementi Park
districts.areas: Upper Bukit Timah · Clementi Park · Ulu Pandan
districts.pov: Quiet, leafy, school-driven. Beauty World rejuvenation continues. Rare landed pockets.

districts.name: Jurong · Boon Lay
districts.areas: Jurong East · Jurong West · Boon Lay · Pioneer
districts.pov: Jurong Lake District = the long-dated regional CBD bet. Watch JRL line + JID land releases.

districts.name: Hillview · Bukit Panjang · CCK
districts.areas: Hillview · Dairy Farm · Bukit Panjang · Choa Chu Kang
districts.pov: Affordable OCR. Family-friendly, nature-fronted. Senja Close EC 2026 in this pocket.

districts.name: Tengah · Lim Chu Kang
districts.pov: Singapore's newest town. Tengah Garden Residences (2026 launch, 863 units) = the test case.

districts.name: Kranji · Woodlands
districts.pov: Causeway corridor. Cheap entry, MY-buyer optionality, JB-RTS post-2027 catalyst.

districts.name: Upper Thomson · Springleaf
districts.pov: TEL-driven boom zone. Lentor cluster (Mansion / Central / Gardens) = supply test through 2026.

districts.name: Yishun · Sembawang
districts.pov: North suburban. Yishun integrated transport + Khoo Teck Puat catchment. Sembawang EC 2026 supply.

districts.name: Seletar · Yio Chu Kang
districts.areas: Seletar · Yio Chu Kang · Jalan Kayu
districts.pov: Aerospace + landed enclaves. Niche; not in the headline upgrader path.
